body.heading: Where in the world is Afghanistan?
paragraphs: Afghanistan is a country in Southern Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Afghanistan is Kabul.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Afghanistan speak Pashto, Dari, Uzbek and Turkmen. Pashto and Dari are the official languages; Dari is understood almost everywhere.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Afghanistan is the Afghan afghani.

body.heading: How big is Afghanistan?
paragraphs: Afghanistan covers about 652,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Malaysia.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Band-e Amir is a chain of deep-blue lakes held back by natural travertine dams in the Hindu Kush mountains — Afghanistan's first national park and a place of striking beauty.
Herat is one of the great historic cities of the Silk Road, with a huge citadel, a famous blue-tiled Friday Mosque and centuries of poetry and art.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Afghanistan on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
